The second surface (docs/interface.md § Surfaces beyond the sheet): the agency-wide 'what is moving' view. Content is real — every decision served 18–25 Aug 2026 and every proceeding with a filing that week, from the store. The tracker's tiles and record-to-date idiom live here, not on the sheet.

Deliberately absent until their extraction exists: next-deadline countdown, stance bars, press releases / Federal Register.
